theory_html:
A. must and must not: rules, warnings, arrangements, reminders

A. must và must not: quy định, cảnh báo, hẹn gặp, tự nhắc nhở

We use must and must not in formal rules and regulations and in warnings:

Dùng must và must not trong quy định, điều lệ trang trọng và trong cảnh báo:

  • Bookings must be made at least seven days before departure.

    Việc đặt chỗ phải thực hiện ít nhất bảy ngày trước khi khởi hành.

  • The government must not be allowed to appoint judges.

    Chính phủ không được phép bổ nhiệm thẩm phán.

In spoken English we often use must and mustn’t (= must not) to propose a future arrangement, such as a meeting or social event, without making detailed plans:

Trong văn nói, ta thường dùng must và mustn’t (= must not) để đề xuất một cuộc hẹn trong tương lai mà chưa lên kế hoạch chi tiết:

  • We must get together more often.

    Chúng ta phải gặp nhau thường xuyên hơn.

  • We mustn’t leave it so long next time.

    Lần sau đừng để lâu như thế nữa.

We can also use I must … to remind ourselves to do something:

Cũng có thể dùng I must … để tự nhắc mình làm gì đó:

  • I must charge my phone. I meant to do it yesterday, but I forgot.

    Mình phải sạc điện thoại. Định làm từ hôm qua mà quên mất.

B. must for conclusions

B. must để rút ra kết luận

To draw a conclusion about something that happened in the past we use must + have + past participle:

Để kết luận về điều đã xảy ra trong quá khứ, dùng must + have + V3:

  • That’s not Clara’s car. She must have borrowed it from her parents.

    Đó không phải xe của Clara. Chắc cô ấy đã mượn của bố mẹ.

something happening at or around the time of speaking we use must be + -ing:

điều đang diễn ra vào/quanh lúc nói, dùng must be + V-ing:

  • I can’t hear a noise. You must be imagining things.

    Tôi không nghe thấy tiếng gì. Chắc bạn đang tưởng tượng thôi.

something that is likely to happen in the future we use must be going to or must be + -ing:

điều có khả năng xảy ra trong tương lai, dùng must be going to hoặc must be + V-ing:

  • ‘What are all those workmen doing?’ ‘I think they must be going to dig up the road.’

    ‘Mấy người thợ kia đang làm gì vậy?’ ‘Tôi nghĩ chắc họ sắp đào đường.’

  • I was wrong about the meeting being today. It must be happening next Friday.

    Tôi nhầm là cuộc họp hôm nay. Chắc nó diễn ra vào thứ Sáu tới.

a present situation we use must be, or have (got) to be in informal speech:

một tình huống hiện tại, dùng must be, hoặc have (got) to be trong văn nói thân mật:

  • Their goalkeeper has got to be at least two metres tall! (or … must be …)

    Thủ môn của họ chắc phải cao ít nhất hai mét!

We can use must have to to say that we conclude something based on what we know about a present situation and must have had to to conclude something about a past situation:

Có thể dùng must have to để kết luận dựa trên hiểu biết về tình huống hiện tại và must have had to để kết luận về tình huống quá khứ:

  • I can’t access the database. You must have to put in a password. (= a password is necessary)

    Tôi không vào được cơ sở dữ liệu. Chắc bạn phải nhập mật khẩu. (= cần có mật khẩu)

  • Matt wasn’t at home when I went round. He must have had to go out unexpectedly.

    Matt không có nhà khi tôi ghé qua. Chắc anh ấy đã phải ra ngoài đột xuất.

Note that we can’t say ‘must’ve (got) to’ but we can say must’ve had to.

Lưu ý: không nói ‘must’ve (got) to’ nhưng có thể nói must’ve had to.

C. have (got) to in questions

C. have (got) to trong câu hỏi

In questions that hope for or expect a negative answer we prefer have (got) to, although in formal contexts must is sometimes used:

Trong câu hỏi mong hoặc đoán câu trả lời phủ định, ta thích dùng have (got) to, dù trong ngữ cảnh trang trọng đôi khi dùng must:

  • Do we have to answer all the questions? (or Have we got to …?; formally Must we …?)

    Chúng ta có phải trả lời hết các câu hỏi không?

We use have to in questions that imply a criticism. Must can also be used, although some people think this is rather old-fashioned. We usually stress have and must in sentences like this:

Dùng have to trong câu hỏi hàm ý chỉ trích. Cũng có thể dùng must, dù một số người thấy hơi cổ. Thường nhấn mạnh have và must trong những câu này:

  • Do you have to play your trumpet here? It’s deafening! (formally Must you play …?)

    Bạn cứ phải thổi kèn ở đây à? Điếc cả tai!

D. have to or have got to?

D. have to hay have got to?

Sometimes we can use either have to or have got to. However, we use have to with frequency adverbs (always, never, normally, rarely, sometimes, etc.):

Đôi khi dùng have to hay have got to đều được. Tuy nhiên, dùng have to với trạng từ tần suất (always, never, normally, rarely, sometimes v.v.):

  • I often have to work at the weekend to get everything done.

    Tôi thường phải làm việc cuối tuần cho xong mọi thứ.

with the past simple we use had to especially in questions and negative sentences:

với quá khứ đơn, dùng had to, nhất là trong câu hỏi và câu phủ định:

  • When did you have to give it back? (not When had you got to give it back?)

    Bạn phải trả lại nó khi nào?

  • We didn’t have to wait too long for an answer. (not We hadn’t got to wait …)

    Chúng tôi không phải chờ câu trả lời quá lâu.

if have is contracted (e.g. I’ve, He’s, It’d) then we must include got:

nếu have được rút gọn (vd I’ve, He’s, It’d) thì phải có got:

  • I need a new pair of shoes, and they’ve got to be blue. (not … they’ve to be …)

    Tôi cần một đôi giày mới, và chúng phải màu xanh.

we don’t use have got to with other modal verbs:

không dùng have got to với các động từ khuyết thiếu khác:

  • Motorists will have to wait until next year to use the bridge. (not Motorists will have got to wait …)

    Người lái xe sẽ phải đợi đến năm sau mới được đi cầu.

Note also that have got to is often preferred in informal speech.

Lưu ý thêm: have got to thường được ưa dùng trong văn nói thân mật.

mcq.question: Bookings ___ be made at least seven days before departure.
mcq.full: Bookings must be made at least seven days before departure.
mcq.vi: Việc đặt chỗ phải thực hiện ít nhất bảy ngày trước khi khởi hành.
mcq.expl:
must / must not for rules, regulations and warnings; We must … (vague future arrangement); I must … (reminder).
must / must not cho quy định, điều lệ và cảnh báo; We must … (hẹn chung chung); I must … (tự nhắc).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Quy định trang trọng → must.
mcq.key: Bookings ___ be made at least seven days before departure.|must

mcq.question: The government ___ be allowed to appoint judges.
mcq.full: The government must not be allowed to appoint judges.
mcq.vi: Chính phủ không được phép bổ nhiệm thẩm phán.
mcq.expl:
must / must not for rules, regulations and warnings; We must … (vague future arrangement); I must … (reminder).
must / must not cho quy định, điều lệ và cảnh báo; We must … (hẹn chung chung); I must … (tự nhắc).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Cảnh báo/quy định → must not.
mcq.key: The government ___ be allowed to appoint judges.|must not

mcq.question: We ___ get together more often.
mcq.full: We must get together more often.
mcq.vi: Chúng ta phải gặp nhau thường xuyên hơn.
mcq.expl:
must / must not for rules, regulations and warnings; We must … (vague future arrangement); I must … (reminder).
must / must not cho quy định, điều lệ và cảnh báo; We must … (hẹn chung chung); I must … (tự nhắc).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Đề xuất hẹn gặp chung chung → must.
mcq.key: We ___ get together more often.|must

mcq.question: We ___ leave it so long next time.
mcq.full: We mustn’t leave it so long next time.
mcq.vi: Lần sau đừng để lâu như thế nữa.
mcq.expl:
must / must not for rules, regulations and warnings; We must … (vague future arrangement); I must … (reminder).
must / must not cho quy định, điều lệ và cảnh báo; We must … (hẹn chung chung); I must … (tự nhắc).
Điểm ngữ pháp: mustn’t = đề xuất (không được để lâu).
mcq.key: We ___ leave it so long next time.|mustn’t

mcq.question: I ___ charge my phone. I meant to do it yesterday, but I forgot.
mcq.full: I must charge my phone. I meant to do it yesterday, but I forgot.
mcq.vi: Mình phải sạc điện thoại. Định làm từ hôm qua mà quên mất.
mcq.expl:
must / must not for rules, regulations and warnings; We must … (vague future arrangement); I must … (reminder).
must / must not cho quy định, điều lệ và cảnh báo; We must … (hẹn chung chung); I must … (tự nhắc).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tự nhắc → I must.
mcq.key: I ___ charge my phone. I meant to do it yesterday, but I forgot.|must

mcq.question: When you have time, we ___ get together for a weekend.
mcq.full: When you have time, we must get together for a weekend.
mcq.vi: Khi bạn rảnh, chúng ta phải gặp nhau một dịp cuối tuần nhé.
mcq.expl:
must / must not for rules, regulations and warnings; We must … (vague future arrangement); I must … (reminder).
must / must not cho quy định, điều lệ và cảnh báo; We must … (hẹn chung chung); I must … (tự nhắc).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Đề xuất hẹn gặp → must.
mcq.key: When you have time, we ___ get together for a weekend.|must

mcq.question: That’s not Clara’s car. She ___ it from her parents.
mcq.full: That’s not Clara’s car. She must have borrowed it from her parents.
mcq.vi: Đó không phải xe của Clara. Chắc cô ấy đã mượn của bố mẹ.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kết luận về quá khứ → must have + V3.
mcq.key: That’s not Clara’s car. She ___ it from her parents.|must have borrowed

mcq.question: I can’t hear a noise. You ___ things.
mcq.full: I can’t hear a noise. You must be imagining things.
mcq.vi: Tôi không nghe thấy tiếng gì. Chắc bạn đang tưởng tượng thôi.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kết luận về lúc nói → must be + V-ing.
mcq.key: I can’t hear a noise. You ___ things.|must be imagining

mcq.question: ‘What are all those workmen doing?’ ‘I think they ___ dig up the road.’
mcq.full: ‘What are all those workmen doing?’ ‘I think they must be going to dig up the road.’
mcq.vi: ‘Mấy người thợ kia đang làm gì vậy?’ ‘Tôi nghĩ chắc họ sắp đào đường.’
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kết luận về tương lai → must be going to.
mcq.key: ‘What are all those workmen doing?’ ‘I think they ___ dig up the road.’|must be going to

mcq.question: I was wrong about the meeting being today. It ___ next Friday.
mcq.full: I was wrong about the meeting being today. It must be happening next Friday.
mcq.vi: Tôi nhầm là cuộc họp hôm nay. Chắc nó diễn ra vào thứ Sáu tới.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tương lai → must be + V-ing.
mcq.key: I was wrong about the meeting being today. It ___ next Friday.|must be happening

mcq.question: Their goalkeeper ___ at least two metres tall!
mcq.full: Their goalkeeper has got to be at least two metres tall!
mcq.vi: Thủ môn của họ chắc phải cao ít nhất hai mét!
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Trạng thái hiện tại (thân mật) → has got to be / must be.
mcq.key: Their goalkeeper ___ at least two metres tall!|has got to be

mcq.question: I can’t access the database. You ___ put in a password.
mcq.full: I can’t access the database. You must have to put in a password.
mcq.vi: Tôi không vào được cơ sở dữ liệu. Chắc bạn phải nhập mật khẩu.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kết luận về tình huống hiện tại → must have to.
mcq.key: I can’t access the database. You ___ put in a password.|must have to

mcq.question: Matt wasn’t at home when I went round. He ___ go out unexpectedly.
mcq.full: Matt wasn’t at home when I went round. He must have had to go out unexpectedly.
mcq.vi: Matt không có nhà khi tôi ghé qua. Chắc anh ấy đã phải ra ngoài đột xuất.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kết luận về quá khứ → must have had to.
mcq.key: Matt wasn’t at home when I went round. He ___ go out unexpectedly.|must have had to

mcq.question: When I left my laptop on the train I thought I’d never see it again. But someone ___ it and handed it in to the lost property office.
mcq.full: When I left my laptop on the train I thought I’d never see it again. But someone must have found it and handed it in to the lost property office.
mcq.vi: Tôi tưởng sẽ không bao giờ thấy lại laptop để quên trên tàu. Nhưng chắc ai đó đã nhặt được và nộp cho phòng đồ thất lạc.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kết luận về quá khứ → must have + V3.
mcq.key: When I left my laptop on the train I thought I’d never see it again. But someone ___ it and handed it in to the lost property office.|must have found

mcq.question: Luisa owns a big car and a yacht. She ___ incredibly rich.
mcq.full: Luisa owns a big car and a yacht. She must be incredibly rich.
mcq.vi: Luisa có xe hơi to và du thuyền. Cô ấy chắc giàu kinh khủng.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Trạng thái hiện tại → must be.
mcq.key: Luisa owns a big car and a yacht. She ___ incredibly rich.|must be

mcq.question: A: Everyone’s going into the hall. B: The meeting ___ soon. Let’s go.
mcq.full: A: Everyone’s going into the hall. B: The meeting must be starting soon. Let’s go.
mcq.vi: A: Mọi người đang vào hội trường. B: Chắc cuộc họp sắp bắt đầu. Đi thôi.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tương lai gần → must be + V-ing.
mcq.key: A: Everyone’s going into the hall. B: The meeting ___ soon. Let’s go.|must be starting

mcq.question: Without things like washing machines and dishwashers our grandparents ___ much harder in the kitchen than we do today.
mcq.full: Without things like washing machines and dishwashers our grandparents must have had to work much harder in the kitchen than we do today.
mcq.vi: Không có máy giặt, máy rửa bát, ông bà ta chắc đã phải làm vất vả hơn chúng ta nhiều.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kết luận về quá khứ → must have had to.
mcq.key: Without things like washing machines and dishwashers our grandparents ___ much harder in the kitchen than we do today.|must have had to work

mcq.question: I didn’t think Rob was coming to the meeting. He ___ his mind.
mcq.full: I didn’t think Rob was coming to the meeting. He must have changed his mind.
mcq.vi: Tôi tưởng Rob không đến họp. Chắc anh ấy đã đổi ý.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kết luận về quá khứ → must have + V3.
mcq.key: I didn’t think Rob was coming to the meeting. He ___ his mind.|must have changed

mcq.question: A: I wonder how you get past security. B: I suppose you ___ some form of ID.
mcq.full: A: I wonder how you get past security. B: I suppose you must have to show some form of ID.
mcq.vi: A: Không biết qua cửa an ninh kiểu gì. B: Tôi đoán chắc phải xuất trình giấy tờ tùy thân.
mcq.expl:
Conclusions: must have + past participle (past), must be + -ing (now/future), must be going to (future), must be / has got to be (present state), must have to / must have had to.
Kết luận: must have + V3 (quá khứ), must be + V-ing (hiện tại/tương lai), must be going to (tương lai), must be / has got to be (trạng thái hiện tại), must have to / must have had to.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Kết luận về tình huống hiện tại → must have to.
mcq.key: A: I wonder how you get past security. B: I suppose you ___ some form of ID.|must have to show

mcq.question: A: I thought Paul would be home. B: He ___ Lotta to work. He said he would.
mcq.full: A: I thought Paul would be home. B: He must be taking Lotta to work. He said he would.
mcq.vi: A: Tôi tưởng Paul ở nhà. B: Chắc anh ấy đang chở Lotta đi làm. Anh ấy bảo thế mà.
mcq.expl:
